Deﬁ nition
Th e term atherosclerosis (AS) comes from the Greek athero,
meaning gruel, and sclerosis, meaning hardening. Th e terms AS
and arteriosclerosis are often used interchangeably. Arterio-
sclerosis is a general term deﬁ ned as a thickening of the walls
of the vessels and a loss of vascular elasticity.
AS is the development of atherosclerotic plaque in the vas-
